def re_arrange_array(arr, n):
    """
    Partition the first n elements in place, matching the supplied example.

    The example contradicts stable ordering: this method preserves the
    order of negative elements but may reorder nonnegative elements.
    """
    if not 0 <= n <= len(arr):
        raise ValueError("n must be between 0 and len(arr)")

    j = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] < 0:
            arr[j], arr[i] = arr[i], arr[j]
            j += 1

    return arr
